title: 7 thinking traps that run your choices

scenes.say: Seven thinking traps run your choices.
Shortcuts save effort. Sometimes they decide for you.
One, anchoring. First numbers set the bar. Two, confirmation bias. You see what agrees. Three, sunk cost. Spending keeps you going.
Four, framing. The wording changes the choice. Five, planning fallacy. Tasks take longer than you think. Six, present bias. Today keeps winning. Seven, illusory truth. Repeated feels true.
Pick the one that catches you most, and notice it once this week. The fix for each is in our latest carousel.
